extracted.name: Burger on a Bun
ingredient_lines: As needed extra virgin olive oil
instruction_lines: Mix all the ingredients for the buns together. Knead and form a ball, coat with coating oil. Cover and let rise till doubled in size.
Mix the water and egg for the eggwash.

Preheat oven to bake 375° Fahrenheit. Divide the dough into sixths. Form into balls. Put on a baking sheet and bake, for 18-20 minutes. Last 5-7 minutes take out put eggwash on top of buns add bake into the oven, for the remaining cooking time.
Mix the ingredients for the burger patties. Form into 6 patties. These can be made ahead of time.
Fry the patties in a skillet till desired doneness.
Build the burger and serve I hope you enjoy!
